purpose: Teach: 小田/富田/天野/遠山/篠原/藤村/須藤/牧野

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 小田部長の歓迎会を準備しましょう
lines.en: Let's get the welcome reception organized for Section Chief Oda.
lines.style: Efficient, task-focused. Clear opening. Practical tone—someone used to moving through a checklist. No hesitation. Forward momentum.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。富田課長の引き継ぎ書を確認します
lines.en: Yes. I'll confirm Manager Tomita's handover notes.
lines.style: Prompt, attentive agreement. Light affirmative nod in the voice. Ready to act immediately. Subordinate but present—not deferential.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 天野技術主任のプロジェクト進捗を共有しましょう
lines.en: Let's share the project update from Technical Lead Amano.
lines.style: Clear directive, collaborative framing. Slightly higher energy than the opening. Purpose-driven. Natural pause between thought and action.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。遠山広報の月次企画書を確認します
lines.en: Yes. I'll check Manager Toyama's monthly plan report.
lines.style: Steady acknowledgment. Slightly lower energy—ongoing task. Methodical. The tone of someone tracking multiple threads without strain.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 篠原顧問との面談を予定しましょう
lines.en: Let's schedule a meeting with Advisor Shinohara.
lines.style: Decisive, forward-looking. Slight emphasis on the action verb. Calm authority. Someone orchestrating a workflow with confidence.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。藤村経理の決算予定を整えます
lines.en: Yes. I'll get Fujimura's closing schedule arranged.
lines.style: Competent affirmation. Steady pace. The reliability of someone handling details without needing reassurance. Clean and efficient.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 須藤人事に新人研修プランを依頼しましょう
lines.en: Let's ask Sudo from HR to prepare the new-hire training plan.
lines.style: Structured task assignment. Deliberate opening. Warm but businesslike—delegating without hesitation. Appropriate delegation pace.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。牧野法務に新契約レビューを依頼します
lines.en: Yes. I'll request the new contract review from Legal—Makino.
lines.style: Final confirmation. Slight finality in the closing. Professional, complete. The tone of wrapping up a list with closure.
